user.title: DEC Deepal — Country
user.description: Choose the country of your Deepal account.

email.title: Sign in by email
email.description:
Enter the email address of your Deepal account. You will receive a code.

Recommended: a secondary account with the car shared to it, so the app on your phone is not signed out.

code_menu.title: Code sent
code_menu.description: Deepal has accepted to send the code to {destination}. It can take a couple of minutes; check the spam folder too. If it does not arrive, resend it or correct the email address.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: Enter the code you have just received.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.description: Your account has several cars. Tick the ones you want to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Deepal session is no longer valid (the same account was probably signed in on the app). A new code will be requested.

error.send_code_failed: The code could not be sent. Check the details you entered.
error.too_many_codes: Too many codes have been requested. Wait a while and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Deepal server.
error.login_failed: Could not sign in. Check the code.

abort.reauth_account_mismatch: That account does not have the same vehicles as the configured one. Sign in with the right account.
abort.catalog_error: One of the integration's catalogues has errors. Check the Home Assistant log.

model.title: Model of {vehicle}
model.description: Until you choose the model, the car works in generic mode (basic data only, without seats, steering wheel or PIN control). Model recognised by name: {suggestion}.

details.title: Version and colour
details.description: Version and colour of your {model}. The version decides which entities are created (for example, seat ventilation only exists on the Max) and, together with the colour, the "DEC image".

data_description.wheels: The Pro always has its 18" wheel.

confirm.title: Add {vehicle}
confirm.description: {vehicle} is in your Deepal account but not in the integration. Press Submit to add it; then the "Set up your vehicle" notice will appear so you can choose its model. If you don't want it in Home Assistant, ignore this notice.

vehicle_removed.title: {vehicle} is no longer in your account

confirm.title: Remove {vehicle}
confirm.description: {vehicle} no longer appears in your Deepal account (was it unshared?). Press Submit to remove it from Home Assistant with its entities. Its maintenance, inspection and insurance records are kept in case it comes back.

session_expired.message: The Deepal session expired and could not be renewed. Sign in again in the integration. ({error})

rate_limited.message: Deepal asks to wait (too many requests or attempts). ({error})

pin_problem.message: Problem with the remote control PIN: check it in the DEC Deepal panel (Settings) or in the official app. ({error})

signing_key_invalid.message: The command signing key is no longer valid. Sign in again in the integration. ({error})

command_not_ready.message: The command cannot be sent yet: {error}

connection_error.message: Could not connect to the Deepal server. ({error})

command_rejected_asleep.message: The car rejected the command ({error}). It may be asleep or busy: try again after using it for a while.

command_rejected_power_on.message: The car must be switched off for this command ({error}). Switch it off and try again.

command_vehicle_asleep.message: The car did not accept the command: it may be asleep or offline. Press "Refresh vehicle data" to wake it up and try again. ({error})

wake_no_report.message: The car was asked to wake up, but it has not sent new data in 60 seconds. It may have no coverage; the last data is kept.

command_busy.message: Another command has been running for this car for too long. Try again in a few seconds.

command_cooldown.message: The car is still finishing the previous command. Wait {seconds} s.

unknown_device.message: That device is not a DEC Deepal vehicle.

maintenance_not_configured.message: First enable servicing for this car in the DEC Deepal panel (Vehicles).

itv_not_configured.message: First enable ITV for this car in the DEC Deepal panel (Vehicles).

maintenance_no_odometer.message: The car's mileage is not known. Enter the kilometres, or register the service from the DEC Deepal panel.

capture_snapshot.name: Debug capture
capture_snapshot.description: Saves a full snapshot of the car's state (interpreted and raw data, without personal data) and compares it with the previous capture. It is also saved in /config/dec_deepal_capturas/.

label.name: Label
label.description: A name to recognise the capture (for example "A - idle").

refresh.name: Read first
refresh.description: Read the car just before capturing.

register_itv.name: Register ITV
register_itv.description: Records that the car has passed the ITV (roadworthiness test) and calculates the next one. ITV must be enabled for the car in the DEC Deepal panel.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The car that has passed the ITV.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the ITV. If left empty, today.

register_maintenance.name: Register service
register_maintenance.description: Records that the car has been serviced and starts counting for the next one. Servicing must be enabled for the car in the DEC Deepal panel.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The car that has been serviced.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the service. If left empty, today.

km.name: Kilometres
km.description: Kilometres at the service. If left empty, the car's current reading.

avisos.key_battery: Key fob battery low. Replace it with a CR2032.
avisos.maintenance_overdue: Service overdue: the {ordinal} service was due on {date} or at {km} km.
avisos.itv_remaining: {days} left until the roadworthiness test (ITV), due by {date}.
avisos.itv_today: Today is the last day to pass the roadworthiness test (ITV).
avisos.insurance_cancel: Insurance: {days} left to cancel (until {deadline}). It renews on {renewal}.
avisos.insurance_last_day: Insurance: today is the last day to tell {company} that you do not want to renew.
avisos.backup_notification: Backup of your vehicles' data. Tap to download it (the link expires in 10 minutes).

tarjeta.card_description: Your Deepal at a glance: car view, battery, comfort and quick actions.
tarjeta.top_card_description: Your Deepal seen from above: doors, bonnet and boot at a glance, with battery, comfort and quick actions.
tarjeta.not_found: I cannot find the car. Choose one in the card settings.
tarjeta.command_failed: The command could not be sent to the car.
tarjeta.no_pin: Enable PIN control in the DEC Deepal panel (Settings tab) to use this button.
tarjeta.pin_confirm: The command will be sent to {name} with your saved PIN. The car may take a few seconds to respond.
tarjeta.vent_q: Open the windows slightly to vent?
tarjeta.no_maintenance: Servicing is not enabled for this car. Enable it in the DEC Deepal panel → Vehicles.
tarjeta.no_itv: ITV is not enabled for this car. Enable it in the DEC Deepal panel → Vehicles.
tarjeta.no_insurance: Insurance is not enabled for this car. Enable it in the DEC Deepal panel → Vehicles.
tarjeta.service_planned: Due on {date} or at {km} km, whichever comes first.
tarjeta.register_service_text: It will be recorded that {name} was serviced today{odometer}, and the count for the next one will start. If it was done on another day, register it from the DEC Deepal panel.
tarjeta.service_failed: The service could not be registered.
tarjeta.itv_rule: First ITV (roadworthiness test) 4 years after registration. Then every 2 years until the car is 10, and every year from then on.
tarjeta.register_itv_text: It will be recorded that {name} passed the ITV today and the next one will be calculated. If it was on another day, register it from the DEC Deepal panel.
tarjeta.itv_failed: The ITV could not be registered.
tarjeta.renewal_text: Renewal on {renewal}. To not renew, you must give notice before {deadline} ({days} days earlier).
tarjeta.trunk_manual: This vehicle has no power tailgate: the boot is opened and closed by hand.

panel.no_cars: There are no vehicles. Add your Deepal account under Settings → Devices and services.
panel.error_generic: That could not be completed. Try again.
panel.when_maintenance_overdue: on the day or when the km are reached
panel.alerts_help: Tick who gets each notification. The pencil changes the days or kilometres of that notification; lead times belong to this vehicle.
panel.error_threshold_range_limits: The lead time must be between {low} and {high}.
panel.error_threshold_range: A lead time is out of range.
panel.error_threshold_order: Lead times must go from longest to shortest: notice 1 before 2, and 2 before 3.
panel.error_not_found: That vehicle is no longer in the account.
panel.error_invalid: Some of the data is not valid.
panel.error_invalid_file: The file is not a DEC Deepal backup, or it is damaged.
panel.error_newer_file: The backup comes from a newer version of the integration. Update DEC Deepal and try again.
panel.error_empty_file: The backup has no data for any vehicle.
panel.backup_help: Servicing, ITV, insurance and appearance of your vehicles. The data belongs to the vehicle: it is not lost when the account is removed.
panel.download_help: A file with the data of every vehicle. It contains the policy number and the insurance phone numbers: keep it somewhere safe.
panel.send_title: Send the backup to a phone
panel.send_help: A notification arrives; tapping it opens the browser and downloads the file. The link expires in 10 minutes.
panel.upload_help: Leaves the vehicles in the file as they were in it. Other vehicles are left untouched.
panel.stored_help: Per vehicle, identified by its VIN.
panel.stored_none: There is no stored data for any vehicle.
panel.delete_confirm: The servicing, ITV and insurance of {name} will be deleted. This cannot be undone: download a backup first if you want to keep them.
panel.history_help: Changes, commands and notifications since the last restart. The same goes into the diagnostics file.
panel.sheets_help: Which equipment the integration assumes, and where it gets it from.
panel.mt_register_help: Records service no. {number} of {name} and starts counting towards the next one.
panel.itv_register_help: Records that {name} has passed the ITV and calculates the next one.
panel.appearance_help: Decides the photo, the view of the vehicle and which equipment is assumed.
panel.trim_full: Heated seats and steering wheel, power tailgate
panel.trim_basic: No heated seats or steering wheel
panel.pin_help: To lock and unlock, windows and boot. It is the PIN of the official Deepal app, with the same account. It applies to every vehicle in the account.
panel.pin_enabled_help: Without this, the card only shows the state of doors, windows and boot.
panel.pin_field_help: It is checked with Deepal on saving. Leave it empty to keep the current one.
panel.mode_direct_help: The command is sent when you tap, after confirming. The most convenient.
panel.mode_armed_help: You first have to enable "Unlock PIN actions", and it only lasts for a while. The safest.
panel.arm_seconds_help: After that time, PIN commands lock again on their own.
panel.arm_notify_help: A notification in Home Assistant every time commands are allowed.
panel.reading_help: How and how often the vehicle is asked.
panel.scan_help: How often the vehicle data is read. Very low values may make Deepal throttle the account.
panel.wake_help: When you tap Refresh and before a PIN command. Never on automatic readings, to protect the 12 V battery.
panel.manual_help: The link the card opens under More → Manual. Empty to use the official one.
panel.debug_help: Stores full requests and responses (without personal data) in the diagnostics.
panel.error_pin_invalid: The PIN is not correct. It is the one from the official Deepal app, with this same account.
panel.error_pin_rate_limited: Too many PIN attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
panel.error_cannot_connect: Could not connect to Deepal. Try again later.
panel.error_invalid_url: The manual link is not valid: it must start with http:// or https://.
panel.error_unknown_model: That model is not in the catalogue.
panel.form_maintenance_off: Disabled: its entities, its indicator on the card and its notifications are removed. The history is lost.
panel.form_itv_off: Disabled: its entities, its indicator on the card and its notifications are removed.
panel.form_insurance_off: Disabled: its entities, its indicator on the card and its notifications are removed.
panel.mt_last_help: If the vehicle has not had any yet, enter the registration date and 0 km.
panel.mt_next_is: The next one will be service no. {number}.
panel.mt_use_odometer: Use the vehicle's current reading ({km} km)
panel.mt_every_help: The manual asks for a shorter interval with repeated short trips, dust, mud, extreme cold or salt.
panel.mt_whichever: Whichever comes first: {date} or at {km} km.
panel.mt_no_plan: This model has no servicing plan in the catalogue.
panel.mt_no_history: No services have been registered yet.
panel.itv_registration_help: It is on the registration certificate. The first ITV is calculated from it.
panel.itv_passed_help: Only if the vehicle has already passed one.
panel.itv_passed: It has already passed an ITV
panel.itv_next_rules: It is calculated with the rules of the account's country.
panel.itv_next_manual_note: If the station gave you a different one
panel.itv_rules: The first at {first} years; then every {interval} and, from {reduced} years on, every year.
panel.itv_no_history: No ITV has been registered yet.
panel.ins_policy_help: The policy number and the phone numbers are only shown on the card and in the panel; they never appear in the diagnostics.
panel.ins_renewal_help: The insurance renews itself every year. To cancel, you have to give notice beforehand.
panel.ins_phones_help: To call with one tap from the card and from here.
panel.ins_preview_passed: That deadline has passed. It renews on {date}.
panel.read_only: Read only: changes are made by a Home Assistant administrator.
panel.people_help: Choose who this car belongs to. These are the people in Settings → People.
panel.error_unknown_person: That person no longer exists in Home Assistant.
panel.error_unauthorized: Only an administrator can make this change.

catalogo.operacion_general_inspection: General inspection (drive unit, battery, high voltage, brakes and steering)
catalogo.operacion_electrics_inspection: Inspection of electrics, air conditioning and coolant hoses
catalogo.operacion_brake_fluid: Brake fluid change (every 2 years or 40,000 km)
catalogo.operacion_front_gear_oil: Front reduction gear oil change (every 3 years or 60,000 km)
catalogo.operacion_rear_gear_oil: Rear reduction gear oil change (every 5 years or 100,000 km)
catalogo.operacion_engine_oil: Engine oil and oil filter change
catalogo.operacion_fuel_system: Fuel system inspection (tank, lines, canister and throttle body)
catalogo.operacion_spark_plugs: Spark plug replacement (every 2 years or 40,000 km)
catalogo.operacion_engine_air_filter: Engine air filter replacement (every 2 years or 40,000 km)
